description: Teammates in crisis during the melee, a difficult choice between retreat and stay, investigators protecting each other amid gunfire and threats

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Three gunshots tore through the air, two bullets precisely piercing Dr. Golan's skull and heart. He fell backward into the darkness like a severed puppet, the dagger slipping from his loosened fingers and striking the concrete floor with a clear, ringing echo. Throughout the process, the howls of the livestock continued to surge, the scorching waves of sound carrying the scent of blood reverberating through the workshop.

conversation.speaker: player9
conversation.text: #Be on high alert and slowly approach the doctor

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: The doctor lay in a pool of dark red blood, his stiffened face frozen in a final expression of shock. That dagger lay quietly in deeper shadows, its tip reflecting a faint glimmer of light.

conversation.speaker: player9
conversation.text: #Fire three more shots

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: The muzzle flashes briefly illuminated the blood pool, bullets piercing the already still body and splattering fresh blood.

conversation.speaker: player9
conversation.text: Should be dead.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: (Ya's position doesn't seem to allow protecting the dagger)

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #After hearing the gunshots, prepare to follow up

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: player8 stepped into the shadows of the main workshop, amidst the surging roars of beasts, a hoarse middle-aged male voice suddenly rang out: "player8?" Her entire body stiffened as if struck by lightning... This was her father's voice.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Are you unharmed?" #Observe him

conversation.speaker: player9
conversation.text: "I'm fine, mission accomplished."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "player8... my daughter..."

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: #Steady your mind, draw your pistol

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Hmm?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Look towards the source of the voice

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: player8 confirmed... that voice was indeed the Professor's, carrying the comforting, warm tone from memory.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Quietly stand to the side observing this family drama

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Come here quickly... how did you get here?"

conversation.speaker: player9
conversation.text: #Holster the gun and stand guard to the side

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: "Your letters led me here. Don't panic, Father, I will soon release you from your suffering, from this blasphemous state."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "I was being hunted by an organization called the Brotherhood of the Skin for possessing that evil dagger. Dr. Golan hid me. I knew the clues I left would lead you here. You are indeed clever and capable. What was that gunfire just now?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Not seeing the person, only hearing the voice, cross arms but don't release the grip on the pistol, trying to gauge if this person is lying

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Come here, let me see you... it's been years, hasn't it... The Professor stands on the platform waving to you. (Psychology check)

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: .ra Psychology

conversation.speaker: player10
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire; if it is what you wish for, it will receive a response. <player4>'s Psychology prayer: D100=56/76 Success

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: #Aim at the head of that creature that looks like Father. To aim more accurately, I need to get closer. Yes, closer. So, slowly walk forward.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: The other's voice is mechanical and cold. You cannot discern any emotion, nor can you conclude whether it's a lie or the truth. "Come here..."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Mina-san"

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: #When feeling that the head can be pierced

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "How about asking something interesting instead."

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: #Pull the trigger

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: player8 steps forward, ascending the gentle slope toward the father above. The slope is covered in a strange, soft, thick substance that feels odd, like a soaked carpet. The air is filled with a sweet, putrid stench mixed with the metallic scent of a slaughterhouse, growing stronger as they approach the platform. In their ears, the roars of livestock echo.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #While saying this, the pistol is already aimed at the shadowy figure above.

conversation.speaker: player8

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "My daughter..." he begins, "Please don't misunderstand Dr. Golan... He is my benefactor..."

conversation.speaker: player8

conversation.speaker: player10

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: The bullet grazes the professor's face, but his expression remains unchanged.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: "Oh being that was once my father, be prepared, for you are no longer human."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Come closer, let me see how much you've grown..."

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: "Even if you imitate his tone, you are definitely not him."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Walks over with a flashlight, ready to shoot.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: "My father would never allow a blasphemous existence like you to remain in this world."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "My daughter..."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Quietly hides behind everyone.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Another hand touches her cheek.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: #Rapidly fires all remaining bullets.

conversation.speaker: player5

conversation.speaker: player9
conversation.text: (About to get a lunchbox.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Triple shot with the handgun.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: #Aim for the head, the face, the heart.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: The movements continue incessantly—the eighth, the ninth... These arms silently emerge from the darkness behind the doctor, varying in skin color and thickness, some covered in coarse hair, others with sharp claws at the fingertips.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: #Shouts with their last breath, "Go start the hydraulic press, crush this monster!"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Below the base, dozens of legs belonging to humans, wolves, and sheep kick at the air and ground in a completely disjointed, frenzied rhythm. They lack any coordination, each acting independently, yet they generate a dizzying propulsive force, allowing this flesh mound to ooze forward in a viscous, determined flow.

conversation.speaker: player9
conversation.text: "Quick... run, we can't defeat it."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: When that distorted monster fully appeared before their eyes, a primal tremor seized everyone's heart... Someone involuntarily took half a step back, someone's knuckles turned white from clenching, in the face of this creation beyond comprehension, all thoughts of resistance turned into a bitter feeling of suffocation in the throat. How can humanity's fragile flesh and blood possibly contend with such an existence?
